Commentary.Commentary: The West Indies side was doing well until the stand of 67 between Blackwood and Samuels. Once they were out, none of the other batsmen showed any stomach to fight as they were easily done and dusted. The visiting side lead by 128 runs and will look to add as many runs as possible to set a handy target for West Indies. Do join us in a bit for India's 2nd innings.

The Indian team have just turned the heat on in this session by picking up 7 wickets. It was all about the comeback bowler Bhuvneshwar Kumar who did justice to his selection in the side. Bhuvi showed  great calibre in this session and notched 5 wickets by not allowing the brisky Blackwood and Co. to score runs. He literally tore the Caribbean side into two halves. Though, he had to wait for a while for his 5th wicket with those dropped catches. Overall, others also supported him by picking up a few.

OUT! FIFER FOR BHUVI! Short ball outside off, Dowrich looks to slash it through the off side but he gets a thick outside edge and the ball goes to Shikhar Dhawan at first slip. He appears to have fumbled it but secures it safely and flings it into the air in triumph. Excellently done by Bhuvneshwar Kumar, who succeeds in getting his third five-wicket haul in Tests!
Short ball on off, defended from within the crease.
FOUR! Back of a length ball on middle, Dowrich plays it fine down the leg side and the lack of a fielder makes sure that the ball goes down to the fine leg boundary.
Length ball on off, defended off the front foot.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.

On middle and off, the ball strikes Gabriel on the thigh-pad.

That is meaty blow! Angles in a full ball, Cummins off his back foot tries to block it but that ball skids in and hits him just above his thigh pad area. There was a stifled appeal for lbw too but was turned down. Though, the replays show it was a clean lbw case and should have been given out as it was hitting the stumps after pitching in line.

The replays from different angles show Rahul pouching it low with cupped hands but the ball bounced just before he got his fingers under it. That is a lucky escape for Shane Dowrich and Bhuvi has been denied his 3rd 5-fer!

Welcome back for the post-lunch session. Marlon Samuels and Jermaine Blackwood will continue to bat. Bhuvneshwar Kumar will begin with the ball first up. The weather is holding up nicely too. Let's play...
... Day 4, Session 2 ...

The duo of Marlon Samuels and Jermaine Blackwood saw the Indian bowlers till the end of the session with their 50-plus stand and kept scoring. It will be interesting to see how they fare in the 2nd session. The visiting side will like to pick up wickets and see off the hosts. Do join us in a bit for the live action.

OUT! That was a close call indeed! The ploy of short ball has worked for Ishant and India! Bouncer on middle and leg, Bravo straightaway goes for a pull, it goes off the top edge behind the wickets. The umpires check if it is a legal delivery and after a lot of retakes, it is decided that the ball is all okay and Bravo has to go back to the pavilion. Hello and warm welcome for Day 3 at Gros Islet. The hosts have done superb work to bowl out the visiting side after a stubborn knock from the duo of Ravichandran Ashwin and Wriddhiman Saha. At one stage their stand was getting heavy on the Caribbean side with their magnanimous 200 plus partnership. The debutant Alzarri Joseph took the prized wicket of Saha. Then, it was all about West Indies as they cleaned the tail of Indian team quickly and batted well to reach a total of 107/1 at the end of day's play.
... Day 3, Session 1 ...

Much hangs in the balance for both sides as the match moves into its third day. West Indies will want to begin the day by eating into India's 246-run lead while India will want to refine its plans of trapping the Windies batsmen. Join us tomorrow at 1930 IST for what looks like an exciting day's cricket. Until then... Cheers and take care!

Earlier in the day, India got off to a good start, with Ashwin and Saha taking their partnership to 213 runs, with both scoring their Test tons. However, Saha's dismissal triggered the Indian batting collapse. Debutant Joseph got the breakthrough for West Indies with Saha's wicket, completing his 3-fer, and Cummins completed their downfall by running through the rest of the batsmen. He picked up three of his own, including Ashwin.

West Indies were off to a steady start as Brathwaite and Johnson continued after Tea but Johnson tried to sneak one in and was run out. That might have ended a 59-run partnership, but Bravo came in and plugged the gap, sticking it out quite well so far. The spinners tried their best to trap the batsmen and might have succeeded in tempting them a couple of times but were not able to get any wickets.

A great way for West Indies to end the day! A rapid-fire session , courtesy the Indian spin attack, and that brings an end to an interesting day of cricket. The first half might have belonged to the visitors but West Indies, literally, took matters back in their own hands in the second half.

FOUR! Wrong line this time by Shami, a touch shortish and sliding down the leg side, Brathwaite does well to nudge it down towards fine leg for a boundary. Just used the pace of the bowler!
Shortish and on off, Johnson taps it down in the gap at covers for a quick single.
Bowls it on the off stump line, on a length, Johnson gets behind the line and blocks it down.
Length delivery shaping away from the left-hander, Johnson has nothing to do with it.
Sshows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Lands it full on off, Brathwaite goes back and pushes it towards wide mid on.
Full in length outside off, driven off the front foot to short extra cover.
Fullish and on off, Brathwaite works it on the leg side but straight to the fielder.
Full in length and outside off, good pace, 139 kph, Brathwaite leaves it alone.
Full in length on middle, angling in, Brathwaite works it through mid-wicket and picks up a couple of runs.

Full delivery and Johnson goes after it. It is a big punch off the back foot and the ball goes over the bowler. Unfortunately, Jadeja is at mid on. He races after it and chases it down before it reaches the ropes at long on. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Length ball on the pads, flicked to square leg for a single.
Fuller ball on leg, defended off the back foot.
Outside off and swinging away, left alone.
Length delivery, Brathwaite shoulders his arms.
Fuller delivery on middle, its an inswinger that gets past Kraigg's defence and thuds into his pads.
MOHAMMED SHAMI with the new ball from the other end.
Good length delivery angled away, Johnson wisely leaves it.
Length ball around off, the ball swings away and beats the outside edge of Johnson's defence.
Length ball outside off, the ball moves away sharply from Johnson and he leaves it.
Down the leg side, Brathwaite lets it through.
Fullish ball on middle and leg, worked to mid-wicket for a single. West Indies are off the mark.
Fuller ball on off, Brathwaite defends it off the back foot to the off side.
